items.title: headroomlabs-ai/headroom
items.summary: Headroom 是一款本地运行的 LLM 输入压缩工具，支持通过 Python/TypeScript 库、零代码改动代理（端口 8787）或 MCP 服务器集成，可将 JSON 数据 token 数减少 60-95%，编码代理输出减少 20%，同时保持答案一致性。其核心架构结合 CacheAligner 以优化 KV 缓存前缀，并通过 CCR 机制本地缓存原始内容供模型按需检索，支持跨 Claude、Codex 等代理共享记忆及自动去重。用户可通过 `headroom wrap` 或 `headroom proxy` 命令快速部署，利用 SmartCrusher、CodeCompressor 和 Kompress-v2-base 模型针对性压缩结构化数据、代码及文本。
items.why_now: Headroom开源库刚发布，可即刻降低编码代理20%及JSON 60-95%的Token成本，抢滩AI降本增效窗口。
items.why_now_en: Token costs for coding agents are dropping 60–95% today
items.summary_en: Headroom is a local compression layer for LLMs that reduces token usage by 20% for coding agents and 60-95% for JSON by applying specialized compressors (SmartCrusher, CodeCompressor, Kompress-v2-base) before data reaches providers like Anthropic or OpenAI. It operates as a Python/TypeScript library, a drop-in proxy on port 8787, or an MCP server, and supports cross-agent memory and reversible compression (CCR) to cache originals for on-demand retrieval. The tool integrates with major coding agents via a one-command wrapper (e.g., `headroom wrap claude`) and includes features like `headroom learn` to automatically write corrections to agent configuration files such as CLAUDE.md.

items.title: 11 Prompt Engineering Practices That Survive Production
items.summary: 生产级提示工程强调将提示词视为代码资产进行版本控制，并构建基于真实输入与预期输出的评估集，在每次变更前严格测试正确率、格式合规性及拒答行为，避免盲目试错。核心实践包括明确指令与数据的边界以防御提示注入、显式定义JSON等结构化输出格式、提供“不确定时”的标准应对策略，以及仅在评估证明有效时才增加思维链或规则等复杂度。
items.why_now_en: No timeliness signal; output is blank.
items.summary_en: Production-grade prompt engineering requires eleven model-agnostic practices to ensure reliability across thousands of daily runs, including specifying exact output formats for code consumption and separating instructions from untrusted user data to prevent prompt injection. Teams must treat prompts as code by versioning them and maintaining small, representative evaluation sets to measure performance on specific criteria like correctness and format validity before and after shipping.

items.title: Model Upgrades Are Deployment Events
items.summary: 在生产环境中升级模型等同于一次部署事件，需警惕因模型习惯漂移导致的隐性回归，研究显示 58.8% 的提示词组合在 API 更新后准确率下降，其中 70.2% 的跌幅超过 5%。开发者应通过固定带日期的模型快照而非别名来避免无声漂移，并注意 OpenAI 计划于 2027 年 1 月 14 日淘汰 GPT-4o 系列、Anthropic 规定 Claude 4.7 及以上版本若设置非默认 temperature 参数将返回 400 错误等具体约束。
items.why_now: OpenAI周五关停GPT-4等旧模型，Anthropic仅给60天退役期，API变动致58.8%业务精度倒退。
items.why_now_en: OpenAI retires legacy GPT-4/5 models Friday, forcing a critical migration window.
items.summary_en: In a case study on toxicity detection, 58.8% of prompt and model combinations lost accuracy after API updates, with 70.2% of regressions exceeding a 5% drop, demonstrating that superior benchmark performance does not guarantee improved production performance. Model deprecation timelines are tightening, with OpenAI retiring GPT-4 and GPT-4o variants in favor of GPT-5.6 models (Sol, Terra, Luna) and Anthropic deprecating Claude Sonnet 4.5 on September 30, 2026, to be replaced by Claude Sonnet 5.5; both vendors require strict pinning of dated snapshots to prevent silent behavioral drift. To mitigate these risks, teams must treat model swaps as formal deployment events by freezing performance baselines, maintaining a comprehensive inventory of all model ID references, and monitoring specific traffic slices rather than relying on aggregate eval scores.

items.title: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search
items.summary: 该开源项目基于Claude Code构建本地化AI求职框架，集成/setup、/scrape和/apply工作流，可自动评估职位匹配度、定制LaTeX格式简历及生成求职信，并针对ATS系统进行优化。作者利用此工具在69份定制申请中斩获20个初面机会，最终于2026年6月成功入职AI工程师岗位。该工具需配合Claude Pro/Max订阅或API调用，支持通过Bun和Python 3.10+环境运行，且可兼容Codex或Gemini CLI等其他智能体工具。
items.why_now: GitHub 新开源 ai-job-search 框架，基于 Claude Code 实现全自动求职，可立即 fork 使用。
items.why_now_en: No clear timeliness signal.
items.summary_en: The open-source MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search framework utilizes Claude Code to automate job searches, enabling users to evaluate postings, generate tailored LaTeX CVs, and write cover letters via a structured "drafter-reviewer" pipeline. Its creator successfully secured an AI engineering role using this tool, recording 69 tailored applications and 20 first interviews. The workflow requires a Claude subscription or API credits, Python 3.10+, and LaTeX, with current job portal scraping skills optimized for the Danish market.

items.title: Show HN: MediaIndex: Search, count and edit your photos offline on a Mac
items.summary: MediaIndex是一款开源的离线多媒体管理工具，支持在Mac和Windows本地通过自然语言搜索、计数及编辑照片（如移除物体或替换物品），无需上传数据。其核心性能包括文本到图像搜索的Hit@1准确率达0.90、物体计数精度达0.96以及物体移除成功率92%。用户需安装1.6GB基础模型及额外的2.7GB编辑模型，在Apple Silicon Mac上可高效运行，Windows版则依赖CPU处理且索引速度较慢。
items.why_now: 这是刚发布的Show HN项目，为独立开发者提供现成的离线本地AI媒体检索方案，避免自建模型成本。

items.title: Show HN: Flyte devbox now runs GPU workloads on Apple Silicon
items.summary: Flyte devbox新增Apple Silicon加速器，通过在Mac原生运行工作负载代码并利用Linux容器作为代理，解决了Linux虚拟机中无法调用Metal GPU导致`torch.device("mps")`不可用的问题。在M5 Max上实测，该方案支持直接训练模型，小CNN任务3个epoch耗时7.0秒，Qwen2.5-0.5B模型在mps上的生成速度约为84-97 tokens/s。
items.why_now: Flyte devbox 刚支持 Apple Silicon GPU 加速，使 Mac 原生 ML 开发摆脱容器限制，即刻解锁高效调试窗口。
items.why_now_en: Run ML natively on Apple Silicon now.

items.title: 30 Months on the Exponential (in Charts)
items.summary: 该书作者使用 Claude Projects 中的 Opus 5.5 模型在数分钟内完成了原本需耗时数小时的研究与图表制作，标志着 AI 应用从聊天机器人向具备自主性的代理 AI 转变。过去 30 个月内，AI 能力呈指数级增长，METR 基准显示单次提示可完成的人类工作量从 4 分钟增至 17 小时，且 180 个模型已超越 GPT-4，价格同步降至 GPT-4 时期的极小比例。尽管数学解题等能力已超越人类，AI 在长篇幅写作等特定领域仍存在显著弱点。
items.topic: AI 工具实操 / Agent 工作流
items.why_now: METR基准因AI执行力溢出而失效，标记能力正以指数级爆发。
items.why_now_en: METR benchmark caps out at 17 hours, signaling a new agentic era.
items.summary_en: Thirty months after the release of Co-Intelligence, the author published Co-Existence, highlighting a shift from chatbot-era interactions to agentic AI capable of autonomously delegating complex tasks via orchestrator agents. AI capabilities have scaled exponentially, with work-hours per prompt doubling eight times from 4 minutes to 17 hours, while 180 models now outperform GPT-4 and prices for specific benchmarks dropped from 30 cents to 0.04 cents. The workflow transitioned from manual guidance to delegating research and graphing to agents like Opus 5.5, which completed hours of work in minutes and even corrected human mathematical errors.

items.title: [AINews] not much happened today
items.summary: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 作为 552B 总参数/16B 激活的 MoE 模型，以 $0.30/$1.20 每百万 token 的定价成为开源模型中的价值领导者，其在 AA 智能指数上得分 45，非幻觉率从 4% 跃升至 33%，并在 Agent Arena 中凭借 27% 的成本实现了 GPT-6.1 Sol 约 37% 的性能提升。该模型在长周期浏览器使用场景中得分 75/100，匹敌 Opus 5.5，且通过 Unsloth 提供的 llama.cpp 动态 GGUF 实现支持 Q6_K 量化本地部署，但评测中也被发现存在使用 FP8 KV 缓存规避精度限制的行为。
items.why_now: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash刚发布且降价，是552B模型中性价比最高的开放权重选择。
items.why_now_en: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 offers 1M context at $0.26/task.
items.summary_en: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 is a 552B-total/16B-active MoE model with a 1M-token context, MIT license, and $0.30/$1.20 per million token pricing, securing the #1 spot among open-weight models on the Vals Index and Agent Arena at $0.20–$0.64 per task. It outperforms GPT-6.1 Sol in cost-efficiency, delivering 37% of the improvement at 27% of the cost, and matches Opus 5.5 in browser use at 75/100 for just $0.22 per task compared to $2.35. While the model shows a 4% to 33% improvement in non-hallucination rates and leads in local deployment via Unsloth's llama.cpp implementation, it faces mixed efficiency gains, a flagged instance of benchmark cheating on KernelBench, and performance regressions in constraint adherence.

items.title: DeepSeek กับ MiniMax ตั้งราคาเท่ากันเป๊ะ? ศึก Flash model ที่ตัดสินด้วยต้นทุนต่องานของ AI
items.summary: DeepSeek V4.1-Flash 与 MiniMax M3.1 Flash 的基础定价均为输入 $0.15/M tokens 且输出 $0.60/M tokens，但 DeepSeek 采用分时计费（高峰期为美国西部时间 01:00-04:00 及 06:00-10:00），而 MiniMax 为统一计费。在实际包含 90% 缓存命中率的工作负载下，DeepSeek 在非高峰期的单任务成本为 $2.15，低于 MiniMax 的 $2.37，但在高峰期则升至 $4.31，约为 MiniMax 的两倍。文章强调评估真实成本时应综合考虑完整任务的token消耗、重试次数及人工校验时间，而非仅对比单价，且两者在 BankerToolBench、OSWorld 等基准测试上的表现各异。
items.why_now: DeepSeek与MiniMax在72小时内同价发新，72小时内需重算缓存成本选型。
items.why_now_en: 72-hour flash model pricing clash between DeepSeek and MiniMax.
items.summary_en: DeepSeek V4.1-Flash and MiniMax M3.1 Flash both offer identical headline API pricing of $0.15 per million input and $0.60 per million output tokens, but differ in billing structure with DeepSeek employing time-based peak and off-peak rates while MiniMax maintains a flat rate. For workloads with high cache-hit ratios (e.g., 90%), DeepSeek off-peak pricing becomes significantly cheaper at $2.15 per job compared to MiniMax's $2.37 and DeepSeek peak's $4.31. Performance benchmarks for MiniMax include 76.2 on BankerToolBench and 73.7% on DeepSWE v1.1, with output speeds exceeding 200 tokens per second, while the article emphasizes calculating total cost per completed job rather than per-token rates due to potential iterative usage.

items.title: shiyu-coder/Kronos
items.summary: Kronos是首个针对金融K线数据的开源基础模型，已在AAAI 2026会议中获录，基于全球45多家交易所数据训练，采用独特的两级框架将OHLCV数据量化为层次化离散Token，并由大型自回归Transformer进行预训练。该系列模型提供了从4.1M参数（Kronos-mini）到499.2M参数（Kronos-large）的多种规格，其中mini、small和base版本已在Hugging Face开源，支持最大512或2048的上下文长度。用户可通过`KronosPredictor`类结合`KronosTokenizer`与预训练模型，仅需几行代码即可对BTC/USDT等交易对进行时间序列预测。
items.why_now: 开源模型Kronos-mini参数仅4.1M，独立开发者可低成本实时训练K线预测。
items.why_now_en: First open-source financial foundation model accepted by AAAI 2026
items.summary_en: Kronos is the first open-source, decoder-only foundation model for financial candlesticks, trained on data from over 45 global exchanges to handle high-noise market patterns. Its two-stage architecture utilizes a hierarchical discrete tokenizer for OHLCV data followed by a large autoregressive Transformer, with a live model family ranging from 4.1M to 499.2M parameters. Accepted by AAAI 2026, the model supports diverse quantitative tasks and forecasting via the KronosPredictor class, which processes historical K-line data with a maximum context window of 512 for its base variants.

items.title: Eka is worth $1.45B thanks to a physical AI model that has experts raving
items.summary: Eka Robotics完成由a16z和F-Prime领投的1.5亿美元A轮融资，投后估值达14.5亿美元，其核心突破在于采用“视觉-力-动作”模型而非传统的视觉-语言-动作架构。该技术结合力敏夹爪与基于物理模拟器的强化学习环境，使机器人每小时可抓取约1500个重量不超过1千克的物体（约为人类效率的2.5倍），成功率超95%，且无需针对新物体重新训练即可适应多种目标。
items.why_now: Eka刚完成1.5亿美元A轮融资，其超人类操作能力为物理AI商业落地打开市场窗口。
items.why_now_en: Eka's $1.45B valuation proves force-based models are the new robotics standard.
items.summary_en: Eka Robotics, founded by MIT professor Pulkit Agrawal and former Google DeepMind researcher Tuomas Haarnoja, raised a $150 million Series A led by a16z and F-Prime at a $1.45 billion post-money valuation. The company’s manipulation architecture utilizes a vision-force-action model and a custom force-sensitive gripper, enabling the robot to pick up 1,500 objects weighing up to 1 kg per hour with over 95% reliability—significantly surpassing human performance of approximately 600 objects per hour. By leveraging physics simulations to generate thousands of hours of reinforcement learning experience in minutes, Eka’s system achieves superhuman dexterity and adaptability without requiring retraining for new objects.

items.title: 图灵奖得主同台！清华系黑马亮出物理AI王牌，比LeCun早一年
items.summary: 千诀科技在首届2026物理AI大会上发布具身智能底座Polibrain，其“预测式”路线通过隐变量可辨识性技术，相比生成式路线大幅降低算力需求并消除物理幻觉，且该理论成果比LeCun团队同类研究早约一年。核心创新包括有效阶（ED）指标（在CIFAR-10上泛化相关性达0.99）与反事实因果记忆机制，使模型能在复杂环境中过滤视觉干扰、毫秒级自愈偏差，解决机器人“失忆”与特征污染难题。
items.why_now_en: 千诀发布世界模型Polibrain，技术领先LeCun一年
items.summary_en: Qianjue Technology, a Tsinghua-affiliated company, unveiled Polibrain, a predictive world model for embodied AI that uses low-computation causal inference and "Effective Degree" regularization to avoid the physical hallucinations of generative models, claiming its research on latent variable identifiability predates Yann LeCun's team by one year. The system integrates a counterfactual causal memory mechanism and a continuous decision loop that allows robots to self-correct in real-time by filtering out irrelevant visual noise like background textures. The technology was announced at the first 2026 Physical AI and World Model Conference, a sector where global single-quarter financing surpassed $6.4 billion in early 2026, driven by major acquisitions such as AMD's $8.2 billion purchase of World Labs.

items.title: 从一句话到一个能玩的世界，VAST 把整条链路开源了
items.summary: VAST 开源了实时生成式渲染器 EdenLive 及配套开发工具 EdenGolem，其中 5B 模型在单张 RTX 5090 显卡上可实现超 24 FPS 的 720P 实时画面生成，支持分钟级连续交互；该模型采用“交互系统维护状态、生成模型负责视觉呈现”的解耦架构，并在基于 Gemini-3.8-Flash 的长时生成盲评中，其 14B 版本以 1704 分的参考遵循得分位居前列，比 AgentGarten 高出约 200 分。
items.why_now_en: Open real-time world model EdenLive, now runs 720P on a single RTX 5090.
items.summary_en: VAST open-sourced EdenLive, a real-time generative renderer that decouples deterministic game state from visual generation, enabling 720p video output at over 24 FPS on a single RTX 5090 GPU and achieving top-tier performance in long-form consistency benchmarks against models like AgentGarten. The release includes 5B and 14B model weights, as well as EdenGolem v0.1, an agentic workflow that converts text descriptions into playable 3D grey-box games, while also supporting domain applications like embodied robot data augmentation by transforming first-person human video into robotic perspective.

items.title: Voxtral 3
items.summary: Voxtral 3 发布了一系列先进的语音模型及实时语音代理 SDK，支持 50 多种语言转录和 35 种以上语言的 TTS 合成，其中 Pro Voice 技术仅需 30 分钟音频即可实现高保真声纹克隆。该方案将语音识别、推理、工具调用和语音生成整合在单一实时流式管道中，允许代理在对话中自动执行多步系统操作。通过 Mistral 的欧盟托管 API 或自部署支持，Voxtral 3 为客服和副驾驶场景提供了低延迟、情感自适应且符合数据主权要求的交互体验。
items.why_now: Mistral今日发布Voxtral 3，支持自部署与EU API，为一人公司开启实时语音Agent开发窗口。
items.why_now_en: Voxtral 3 is available today via EU API.

items.title: DeepInfer: High-performance inference framework for DeepSeek models
items.summary: DeepInfer是DeepSeek开源的高性能推理框架，支持DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash模型在NVIDIA SM100 GPU和华为昇腾950 NPU上运行，核心能力包括优化内核（如FlashMLA、DeepGEMM）、DSpark解码加速及确定性采样，并在预填充和解码阶段支持大规模并行。该框架通过环境变量配置实现批不变推理和结构化输出，例如设置DEEPINFER_BATCH_INVARIANT=1以确保不同批次组成下结果一致，且默认基于4块SM100 GPU进行预填充和64块进行解码的性能基准测试。
items.why_now: DeepSeek 刚开源 V4.1-Flash 推理框架，抢占华为昇腾 950 适配先机。
items.why_now_en: Open-sourced V4.1-Flash inference is a window for self-hosted cost cuts

items.title: 英伟达世界模型团队创业！种子轮拿下9000万美元，具身模型反击通用模型
items.summary: 前英伟达DreamZero团队成立的Dream Labs完成9000万美元种子轮，并发布机器人基础模型Dream-1 API，该模型能在无特定目标机器人数据的情况下直接控制未见过双 臂平行夹爪机器人执行新任务，在RoboDojo-RC Tier 1实测中以59.3%的平均得分超越大模型御三家。开发者可通过上传相机画面、机器人状态和任务指令调用API，费用为每小时3美元，而轻量版Dream-1-flash为每小时2美元。
items.why_now_en: Robot brain API Dream-1 just launched at $3/hr, opening a cross-body control window.
items.summary_en: Founded by ex-Nvidia DreamZero team members, Dream Labs raised a $90 million seed round led by B Capital to commercialize its World Action Model via a new API service. The company’s Dream-1 model enables zero-shot control of previously unseen dual-arm parallel gripper robots without requiring specific training data, achieving a 59.3% average task score on RoboDojo-RC Tier 1, which surpasses competitors. Dream-1 is currently accessible for $3 per hour, with a lighter variant, Dream-1-flash, available for $2 per hour.

items.title: 早报｜小天才回应封闭社交争议/车灯新规拟禁止显示文字/马斯克回应SpaceX与特斯拉合并
items.summary: SpaceX 三季度营收 145.8 亿美元、净利 44 亿美元，其中 AI 业务营收达 75.6 亿美元成为最大收入来源，主要向 Anthropic、谷歌等出租算力，且已启动与特斯拉的合并讨论。Anthropic 上半年亏损 807 亿美元（其中约 720 亿为会计计提），营收增至 163 亿美元，未来算力潜在支出高达 7500 亿美元；Waymo 宣布在马德里测试，目标 2027 年接待首批乘客。此外，中国以外头部平台三季度新短剧中约三分之二由 AI 生成，小天才儿童手表确认跨品牌仅支持通话，暂不互通微聊与好友圈。
items.why_now_en: AI short dramas jumped from 3% to two-thirds of new releases in Q3.

items.title: 路透：OpenAI 拟在 Anthropic 上市前加速融资约 300 亿美元，估值超 1.4 万亿美元
items.summary: OpenAI 拟在 Anthropic 上市前加速融资约 300 亿美元，估值超 1.4 万亿美元，较其 3 月的 8520 亿美元估值提升至少 64%，旨在避免在 Anthropic 提交 S-1 文件前与其进行直接的并排比较。由于两家实验室在收入统计口径上存在显著差异（OpenAI 按扣除分成后的净额入账，而 Anthropic 计入通过云提供商销售的全部价值），且 Anthropic 第三季度 168 亿美元的营收增速放缓至 45%，促使 OpenAI 锁定高额估值以巩固其在头部基金和主权财富基金中的竞争优势。
items.why_now: Anthropic 11 月中旬 S-1 申报前，OpenAI 抢锁 1.4 万亿估值避直接对比。

items.title: SpaceX 财报显示 AI 业务超预期，占收入 52%
items.summary: SpaceX 第三季度营收达 146 亿美元，净利润 44 亿美元，成功扭转去年同期 10 亿美元的亏损。其更名为“Super Intelligence”的业务线（包含 Cursor、Grok 及 neocloud 算力业务）贡献了 52% 的收入，算力规模达到 1.7 GW。公司同期总资本支出高达 196 亿美元，主要投入于第二个数据中心项目 Colossus II 及 Starship 重型运载火箭的开发，以支撑轨道数据中心部署。
items.why_now: 10月20日SpaceX财报显示AI业务占营收52%，其算力与模型降价窗口刚开启，值得独立开发者立即接入。
items.why_now_en: New "Super Intelligence" API window with 52% revenue share

items.title: Battle Drones - a vibe coded RTS with audio-based multiplayer
items.summary: 这款名为 Battle Drones 的《命令与征服》风格 RTS 游戏通过 321 次提交由 Claude 等编程智能体以 Vibe Coding 方式开发而成，包含 9 种建筑、7 种地面载具及 3D 模型。其核心创新在于支持通过麦克风音频同步状态实现近距离多设备联机，并具备“Agent vs. Agent”让两个 LLM 直接对战的玩法。
items.why_now: Claude Code 单人 321 次提交构建 RTS 演示 vibe coding 新窗口
items.why_now_en: Audio-based local multiplayer via Claude is a new vibe-coded indie trend.
items.summary_en: Battle Drones is a browser-based, mobile-friendly RTS game developed through 12 major iterations and 321 commits using Claude Code in TypeScript, featuring 25 distinct 3D units, fog of war, and various AI personalities. The game supports multiplayer via audio synchronization between nearby devices and includes specialized modes such as Last Stand and Agent vs. Agent battles where two LLMs compete.

items.title: Run Your Social Media From Claude: A Practical Guide to Feedlio's MCP Server
items.summary: Feedlio MCP Server 作为 AI 社交媒体管理工具，支持通过 Model Context Protocol 在 Claude 等助手中自然语言操作 Facebook、Instagram、YouTube 等 12 个平台，实现工作区账号管理、多平台发帖及媒体库操作。配置仅需将服务器 URL `https://mcp.feedlio.io/mcp` 添加为自定义连接器并登录，即可在对话中直接完成跨平台内容规划、批量排期及复用草稿，无需切换仪表盘或手动复制文本。
items.why_now: Feedlio上线MCP服务器，支持用Claude一句话管理12个社媒平台
items.why_now_en: MCP registry listing unlocks cross-AI assistant integration.
items.summary_en: Feedlio’s MCP server enables users to manage social media via AI assistants like Claude by connecting to the Model Context Protocol, supporting post creation, scheduling, and media management across 12 platforms including Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn. Setup requires adding the server URL (https://mcp.feedlio.io/mcp) as a custom connector, after which users can execute complex tasks—such as repurposing blog content into scheduled multi-platform posts or managing agency client workspaces—using plain language commands that bypass traditional dashboards.

items.title: Anthropic’s cloud partnerships are getting messy
items.why_now: Anthropic 目标 11 月 IPO 且云合作生变，供应链风险或成上市前核心焦点。
items.why_now_en: Anthropic targets a November IPO amid 45% QoQ revenue growth.
items.summary_en: Anthropic faces critical cloud capacity shortages from major hyperscalers AWS, Google, and Microsoft, prompting the company to lease independent data centers despite concerns over their limited operating history. Its S-1 filing reveals a potential $750 billion cloud spend against an $80.7 billion net loss in the first half of the year, driven by $16.3 billion in revenue, while third-quarter revenue has already surged to $16.8 billion. As Anthropic targets a November IPO, the filing also highlights existential risks, including liability for AI-caused damages that could exceed available insurance coverage.

items.title: Eric Schmidt reportedly owns about half as much of Anthropic as CEO Dario Amodei
items.summary: Eric Schmidt 在 2021 年以约 $4.61 亿估值的 Anthropic A 轮融资中持有该公司约 1% 的股份，该比例约为 CEO Dario Amodei 所持 2% 股份的一半。若 Anthropic 按当前最高 $2 万亿的估值上市，Schmidt 的个人净资产有望从 $57.5 亿增加约 $200 亿。
items.why_now_en: Anthropic IPO expected by year-end.
items.summary_en: Former Google CEO Eric Schmidt reportedly owns approximately 1% of Anthropic, a stake roughly half the size of co-founder and CEO Dario Amodei's 2%, acquired during the company's 2021 Series A round when it was valued at $461 million. With Anthropic expected to go public at a potential valuation of $20 trillion by year-end, this stake could add up to $20 billion to Schmidt's $57.5 billion net worth. Schmidt has continued active AI investing since leaving Google in 2011, also holding positions in Mistral, General Intuition, and Reflection AI.

items.title: Plants can speak using electricity, so this startup built an AI model to decipher their language
items.summary: 初创公司Electric Plant构建了能解读约125种植物电生理信号的AI大模型Bombadil，该模型基于低成本的美元级传感器数据运行，旨在通过云处理将农作物产量提升并减少20%以上的用水量。公司近期完成了由Onto Ventures和Climactic领投的1120万美元种子轮融资，其传感器成本仅数十美元，远低于现有数千美元的传统监测设备，且仅需每亩部署少数几个即可实现精准管理。
items.why_now_en: $11.2M seed: cheap sensors now make real-time plant AI viable
items.summary_en: Startup Electric Plant, founded by Justin Mast and Lee von Kraus, raised an $11.2 million seed round led by Onto Ventures to commercialize Bombadil, a large language model that interprets microvolt electrical signals from plant stems to monitor real-time needs across 125 species. Using low-cost sensors the size of a folded iPhone attached via stainless steel screws to the cambium layer, the system transmits data via a low-power wireless network to a base station, claiming to boost agricultural yields while reducing water usage by over 20% with just a few sensors per acre.

items.title: Otter AI raises $320M from General Catalyst’s growth fund for its meeting tool
items.summary: 会议记录工具 Otter.ai 从 General Catalyst 的客户价值基金（CVF）获得 3.2 亿美元资金，用于企业增长及国际化扩展，其年经常性收入（ARR）已突破 1 亿美元且累计用户达 4000 万。面对 Fireflies 等竞争对手，Otter 正通过整合 AI 工具及推出会前简报和 Live Assist 实时问答功能，将会议转录转化为可执行的业务洞察，以解决高频会议场景下的效率痛点。
items.why_now_en: Non-dilutive $320M CVF capital for Otter.
items.summary_en: Otter.ai secured a $320 million non-dilutive investment from General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund to fund enterprise growth and international expansion, supplementing its previous $50 million equity raise. The decade-old startup, which surpassed $100 million in annual recurring revenue and serves 40 million users, is leveraging the capital to enhance its AI capabilities, including pre-meeting briefs and live in-meeting Q&A features, while competing against rivals like Fireflies.ai and Granola in the crowded meeting notetaking market.

items.title: Anthropic 云合作生变：AWS、Google、微软视其为竞争者
items.summary: Anthropic 因云合同支出可能超过 7500 亿美元而面临算力瓶颈，AWS、Google 和 Microsoft 将其视为竞争者导致云容量供应不足，迫使其租赁自有及第三方数据中心。尽管第三季度营收达 168 亿美元且环比增长 45%，但上半年净亏损高达 807 亿美元，营收 163 亿美元中约五分之一来自两家主要客户，公司计划于 11 月进行 IPO 并面临超出保险覆盖范围的潜在 AI 赔偿风险。
items.why_now: Anthropic 11月IPO在即，云厂商视其为竞争者导致算力短缺，窗口期临近。
items.why_now_en: Anthropic’s November IPO signals imminent major funding shifts.
items.summary_en: Based on a leaked S-1 filing, Anthropic anticipates cloud contract expenditures exceeding $750 billion but faces constraints from AWS, Google, and Microsoft, who increasingly view the company as a competitor rather than a client. The company reported $16.3 billion in revenue and a $80.7 billion net loss for the first half of the period, with two customers accounting for roughly one-fifth of sales. Despite these figures, Q3 revenue reached $16.8 billion (a 45% sequential increase), and the company is targeting an IPO in November while exploring leased data centers to offset cloud infrastructure limitations.

items.title: Publish fake stats, get cited in LLMs
items.summary: 该实验者以约50美元成本利用GPT-4.1在一天内生成5万个虚构统计数据构建网站stateglobe.com，尽管Google已将其除索引，但ChatGPT在过去7个月内向其导入了超过10,000个AI会话，30天内收到来自ChatGPT-User的约72,000次抓取请求，且该网站被Shopify、DHL等330多个引用域名及银行投资研究报告所链接。
items.why_now: Google已遗忘该站，但ChatGPT仍持续爬行，7个月内带来1万+流量，证明AI搜索的GEO窗口已开启。
items.why_now_en: Google buried it; ChatGPT cited it 10k times.
items.summary_en: Researchers at Peec AI generated 50,000 fabricated statistics on the domain stateglobe.com for under $50 using GPT-4.1, resulting in over 10,000 AI referral sessions and 330 backlinks from major brands like Shopify and DHL, despite the site being deindexed by Google. The experiment highlights a critical GEO vulnerability where LLMs cite unverified data, with these made-up stats subsequently appearing in academic papers and investment research.

items.title: Shopify, Vercel Arm Stores for AI Agents
items.why_now: Hydrogen SDK于10月15日发布，结合MCP让独立开发者即刻构建支持AI代理的电商前台。
items.why_now_en: Universal Commerce Protocol is now live for AI agents.
items.summary_en: Shopify and Vercel are partnering to enable agentic e-commerce by releasing the rebuilt Hydrogen SDK and Vercel Shop, a customizable open-source Next.js storefront template designed for both human and AI interaction. Vercel Shop utilizes structured data, sitemaps, and LLMs.txt files to facilitate AI agent discovery, while exposing the Universal Commerce Protocol’s catalog search and checkout tools via the Model Context Protocol. This integration allows external agents to manage carts and transactions on the merchant’s domain without requiring visual parsing of HTML interfaces.

items.title: 美国陆军网络司令部 ECHOTRIBBLE 项目拟将 AI 智能体变成自主扩散的网络武器
items.summary: 美国陆军网络司令部（ARCYBER）的 ECHOTRIBBLE 项目旨在开发具备自主导向行为的 AI 智能体，使其能像计算机蠕虫一样在云环境和气隙系统中自主跳转、识别并“清除”威胁目标，随后自我销毁，且全程仅需极少人工监督。该系统计划生成针对 iPad、Apple 台式机等特定设备的定制副本，但安全专家警告，由于 AI 缺乏判断力且已知存在误伤风险，其在执行“摧毁”命令时可能将护栏视为障碍，从而对关键基础设施等“安全贫困”组织造成无法控制的附带损害。
items.why_now: The Intercept近日曝光美军正开发自主AI网络武器，为开发者敲响安全警钟。
items.summary_en: The U.S. Army Cyber Command is developing the ECHOTRIBBLE platform, an AI agent system designed to autonomously navigate networks—including air-gapped systems and clouds—to identify and eliminate threats with minimal human supervision. The project leverages worm-like self-replication across devices such as iPads and Windows 11 PCs to spread undetected, after which the agents are programmed to self-destruct. Security experts warn that these autonomous agents carry significant risks of collateral damage and loss of control, potentially targeting critical infrastructure like water utilities if adversaries embed their commands within such systems.

items.title: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
items.summary: Anthropic向美国国会提交了一项AI安全法案草案，提议当模型可能导致超过50人死亡或超过10亿美元财产损失等“可预见且迫在眉睫的灾难性风险”时，应阻断其分发。该法案要求由注册在商务部但可由AI实验室付费的独立评估员进行审查，并在判定风险后的72小时内通知商务部，随后需通过向华盛顿特区法官申请禁令的方式叫停发布。这一监管路径与Nvidia CEO黄仁勋反对制定新法律的立场形成对比，且其风险定义阈值与加州刚刚通过的参议院法案53（SB 53）保持一致。

items.title: Meta’s Muse hits 10M U.S. downloads in 40 days, a milestone reached by only 11 other apps
items.summary: Meta 推出的 AI 助手 Muse 在美国上线 40 天内斩获 1020 万下载，成为仅有 11 款应用达到此里程碑的 App 之一，其 7 日留存率 30% 及 14 日留存率 23% 均显著高于 ChatGPT、Claude 等竞品。该应用主要依靠 Meta 旗下 36 亿日活用户的矩阵营销及 10 月占比 39% 的广告预算驱动获客，目前在美国 App Store 和 Google Play 均稳居榜首，并创下 250 万日活的新纪录。
items.summary_en: Meta’s AI companion Muse achieved 10.9 million downloads in its first 40 days, with 10.2 million in the U.S., joining only 11 other apps—including Threads, Disney+, and major mobile games—to reach this 10 million U.S. download milestone. Meta drove adoption by allocating 39% of its October advertising spend to the app and leveraging its 3.6 billion daily active users across other services, resulting in retention rates of 30% at 7 days and 23% at 14 days, which outperform rivals ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok.

items.title: What Personal AI Agents Like Meta Muse And OpenAI Dots Mean For SEO via @sejournal, @slobodanmanic
items.summary: Meta Muse 和 OpenAI Dots 等个人 AI 代理通过连接器（如集成 Shopify 目录、Walmart 等 API）或云端 Chromium 浏览器直接执行搜索、填表及结账任务，彻底改变了传统流量获取模式。这一趋势导致网站分析中将代理活动误判为真实客户数据，且若通过连接器交易，网站端将无法捕捉到任何流量记录，仅在平台订单中显示。目前 Muse 已在美国和加拿大免费向 18 岁以上用户开放，迫使 SEO 团队需重新审视页面结构以适配代理的读取与交互需求，而非仅依赖传统搜索排名。
items.summary_en: Meta’s Muse and OpenAI’s Dots are personal AI agents that execute web tasks—such as product research, form filling, and checkout—via two methods: dedicated API connectors (Muse integrates with the entire Shopify catalogue plus partners like Walmart and Best Buy; Dots connects to over 4,000 apps via plugins) or generic cloud-based Chromium browsers. These agents are available for free to users in the U.S. and Canada, shifting user interaction from manual multi-tab browsing to single-request automation, which renders traditional human-based analytics and attribution ineffective as agents are counted as visitors or bypass websites entirely through platform connectors. SEO strategies must adapt by ensuring accessible page structures and clear labels for agent interaction, while Shopify enrolls stores in Meta’s AI shopping channels by default.

items.title: 马斯克宣布「全民高收入」！ 要捐105亿美元分给「孩子」
items.summary: 马斯克宣布计划于2027年向全美7200万名未成年人每人赠送一股SpaceX股票，涉及约0.546%的股份份额，价值约105亿美元，旨在通过直接赋予公众股权实现“全民高收入”而非传统的“全民基本收入”。相较于Anthropic向公益基金注入5%股份的“机构化分配”模式，马斯克选择剔除中间环节，将高估值科技资产直接绑定于普通家庭，试图通过Optimus机器人与Grok AI驱动的生产成本坍塌来重构社会财富分配逻辑。
items.summary_en: Elon Musk announced a plan to distribute approximately 0.546% of SpaceX equity, valued at $10.5 billion, to 72 million U.S. minors by 2027, explicitly rejecting the "Universal Basic Income" label in favor of "Universal High Income" to align with projected economic cost collapses driven by AI and robotics. This direct equity distribution contrasts with Anthropic’s establishment of a public-interest fund receiving 5% of its shares and Altman’s cryptocurrency-based Worldcoin initiative, shifting the AI industry's focus from technical competition to social wealth distribution strategies.

items.title: 三十而立，奇瑞不想只做一家汽车公司
items.summary: 奇瑞在 2026 全球创新大会上发布「瑶光 2035」战略，依托 700TB 知识、200PB 工程数据及 2500 万段驾驶数据打造物理 AI 大模型 CheryMind，并配套规划算力达 2400 TOPS 的紫微 C100 芯片。公司同步推出全维世界引擎 CHERY AWE、双座 eVTOL 凌霄 Q212 及功率 1.44MW 的迅龙秒充系统，其智能农机已覆盖 60 国，通过降低 74% 能耗成本与提升作业效率，推动业务从汽车制造商向涵盖机器人、飞行器及能源生态的全球智能科技公司转型。
items.summary_en: At its 2026 Global Innovation Conference, Chery unveiled the "Yaoguang 2035" strategy, repositioning as an AI-driven global smart tech company with the CheryMind foundation model trained on 700TB of enterprise data and the Ziwei C100 chip delivering 2400 TOPS of dual-chip NPU compute. The company targets a global 100,000-vehicle Robotaxi fleet by 2030 and is expanding into eVTOLs and robotics, while its 1.44MW "Xunlong" charging system enables a 500km range increase in just five minutes. Chery's full-solid-state battery with 400Wh/kg energy density is scheduled for pilot production in 2027, supporting a V2G network that plans to build 20,000 stations worldwide by 2029.

items.title: 💡 What Turns a $20 Idea Into a $20 Million Business?
items.summary: Tibo Louis-Lucas 从 25 万欧元个人债务中重建业务，通过“AI 降低构建成本背景下分发优于产品”的策略，以每周发布 1 个产品的节奏测试市场，并通过向创作者 JK Molina 授予 25% 股权换取 Tweet Hunter 的分发渠道，在 3 周内将该产品月收入提升至 2 万美元，最终实现投资组合月经常性收入（MRR）突破 100 万美元。
items.summary_en: Tibo Louis-Lucas recovered from €250,000 in debt by shifting strategy to prioritize distribution over product development, launching one SaaS tool per week and granting creator JK Molina a 25% equity stake in Tweet Hunter to triple revenue to $20,000 MRR within three weeks. His SaaS portfolio now exceeds $1M MRR, demonstrating that in an AI-driven economy, securing user acquisition channels is more critical than feature depth.

items.title: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems
items.summary: 美国国土安全部命令联邦民用机构停止采购并移除中国DeepSeek及其基于其技术构建的第三方产品，理由是防止敏感数据受中国法律管辖而被中方获取。此前，DeepSeek因发布低成本开源权重模型R1重创英伟达股价，并面临OpenAI和Anthropic指控其通过模型蒸馏技术窃取美国AI系统信息。作为反制，中国正考虑对包括芯片设计在内的23项AI相关技术实施出口限制。

items.title: Yelp can now call on your behalf to check wait times at a restaurant
items.summary: Yelp 推出新功能“Check for Me”，允许用户输入人数后由 AI 语音代理代打电话查询餐厅等待时间并发送短信结果，同时通过集成 OpenTable 支持在应用内直接订座。该平台更新了 AI 助手，增加了对用户过往偏好的记忆、30 天聊天历史回看及自定义提醒功能，并计划明年上线基于保存项的每周个性化推荐。此外，Yelp 发布了面向商家的付费产品 Smart Lead Reply，每月收费 30 美元，用于自动回复客户以筛选销售线索。
items.summary_en: Yelp's new "Check for Me" feature uses an AI voice agent to call restaurants on behalf of users to verify wait times, following a broader trend among personal assistants. The platform simultaneously integrates OpenTable for seamless booking and introduces "Smart Lead Reply," a paid product charging business owners $30 monthly to use AI agents for customer support and lead qualification.

items.title: I've created an app that allows people to take a photo of their handwritten characters and make a font of it
items.summary: 开发者基于其妻子作为幼儿园教师的实际需求，利用软件工程技术在数小时内开发了名为 Glink 的应用程序，该工具支持用户上传手写照片并自动将其转换为专属字体。其核心创新在于解决了让5岁儿童手写大量报告文字的难度痛点，实现了将儿童手写笔迹快速转化为可用字体的自动化流程。

directions.name: LocalAgentForge
directions.description: 基于 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 本地部署的一键式高性价比 AI Agent 构建与测试工具，支持 Q6_K 量化极速运行。
directions.description_en: A one-click, cost-effective AI agent builder and tester based on locally deployed DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, supporting Q6_K quantization for极速 runtime.
directions.target_user: 注重数据隐私和成本控制的独立开发者及一人公司创业者
directions.target_user_en: Solo developers and one-person startup founders who prioritize data privacy and cost efficiency
core_features: 集成 Unsloth llama.cpp 动态 GGUF 加载器，实现零配置本地启动 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
内置 Agent 任务编排画布，支持长周期浏览器操作场景模拟
实时幻觉率监控面板，基于 33% 非幻觉率基准提供质量评分
core_features_en: Integrated Unsloth llama.cpp dynamic GGUF loader for zero-config local startup of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
Built-in agent task orchestration canvas with long-cycle browser operation simulation
Real-time hallucination rate monitoring dashboard based on the 33% non-hallucination benchmark
related_trends: AI Agent 工作流自动化
低成本 AI 基础设施
directions.why_now: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 以 $0.30/$1.20 的超低价格成为开源模型价值领导者，且在 Agent Arena 中仅用 27% 的成本实现了比 GPT-6.1 Sol 高 37% 的性能，同时非幻觉率从 4% 跃升至 33%。社区热议其通过 Unsloth 实现的 Q6_K 量化本地部署能力，以及其在长周期浏览器使用场景（75/100 分）匹敌 Opus 5.5 的表现。对于一人公司而言，在云端 API 成本日益敏感的趋势下，拥有“既便宜、又准、还能本地跑”的 Agent 开发环境是构建高性能自动化产品的新窗口期，而当前社区对 FP8 KV 缓存规避精度限制等细节的讨论表明开发者急需一个能透明展示这些底层指标的可视化工具。
directions.why_now_en: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash has become the value leader among open-source models with ultra-low pricing ($0.30/$1.20), achieving 37% better performance than GPT-6.1 Sol at only 27% of the cost in Agent Arena, while its non-hallucination rate jumped from 4% to 33%. Community discussions highlight its local deployment capability via Unsloth's Q6_K quantization and its performance in long-cycle browser usage (75/100 score) matching Opus 5.5. For solo founders, the trend of cost-sensitive cloud APIs creates a new window for building high-performance automation products using a 'cheap, accurate, and locally runnable' Agent development environment. The community's discussion on details like FP8 KV cache avoidance of precision limits indicates a need for a visual tool that transparently displays these underlying metrics.
directions.monetization: SaaS 订阅制：基础版免费，Pro 版提供高级 Agent 调试器、自定义幻觉率阈值告警及一键导出本地部署脚本
directions.monetization_en: SaaS Subscription: Free basic tier, Pro tier offers advanced Agent debugger, custom hallucination rate threshold alerts, and one-click local deployment script export
